map.：某港一天两高两低，高潮 3.8m/3.6m、低潮 0.9m/1.1m，平均潮差: : A certain port has two highs and two lows per day, with highs 3.8m/3.6m and lows 0.9m/1.1m, so the mean tidal range ≈(3.8−0.9+3.6−1.1)/2=2.7m, a regular semidiurnal tide.
map.：船舶吃水 4m、安全富余 0.5m → 需潮高≥4.5m，查时序仅高潮前后 1: : With a draft of 4m and a 0.5m under-keel margin, a tide height of at least 4.5m is needed; the time series shows only about 1.5h around high tide satisfies this, so the berthing window is set accordingly.
